question: In which year was the first World Environment Day (WED) celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1974**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first World Environment Day (WED) was celebrated in the year **1974**.
 
• World Environment Day is celebrated every year on **June 5**, and it is the United Nations' principal vehicle for encouraging awareness and action for the protection of the environment.
 
• The day was established by the UN General Assembly in **1972** on the first day of the Stockholm Conference on the Human Environment, leading to the establishment of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).
 
• Each year, WED is hosted by a different country, in which official celebrations take place, and the event has a specific theme that focuses on pressing environmental issues.
 
• The day provides a global platform for public outreach, with participation from over **143 countries** annually.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The theme for World Environment Day 2021 was **"Ecosystem Restoration"**, focusing on resetting our relationship with nature.
 
• World Environment Day has grown to become a global platform for public outreach, with participation from over 143 countries annually.
 
• UNEP uses the day to promote worldwide awareness and action for the environment, addressing issues such as marine pollution, human overpopulation, global warming, sustainable consumption, and wildlife crime.
 
• The day is celebrated in various ways worldwide, including street rallies, parades, concerts, school competitions, tree planting, and clean-up campaigns.
